system.description: A Focus for a character whose body is partly or fully machine.

abilities.name: Defensive Cybernetics
abilities.description: Durable mechanical parts let you rally to remove a minor or moderate wound without spending Might.

abilities.name: Hidden Shield
abilities.description: A concealed built-in shield works as a light melee weapon and can make a hindered extra attack.

abilities.name: Powered Cybernetics
abilities.description: Physical tasks to carry, climb, jump, or smash count rolls below 9 as 9; Effort raises the minimum by 3 and it becomes 12 at tier 3.

abilities.name: High-Speed Interface
abilities.description: Directly connect to a nearby machine to ease tasks to identify and operate it at machine speed.

abilities.name: HUD
abilities.description: A heads-up display improves vision in darkness and obscuring conditions; Effort unlocks combat, magnifier, and scanner modes.

abilities.name: Enhanced Self-Repair
abilities.description: Reduce the Might cost of rallying to remove a wound by 2.

abilities.name: Weaponization
abilities.description: Embed a light or medium one-handed weapon or a multitool; you are trained in the chosen equipment.

abilities.name: Deep Reserves
abilities.description: Transfer up to 6 points among Pools at one point per round; renews after a ten-hour recovery.

abilities.name: Fusion
abilities.description: Fuse manifest cyphers and artifacts with your body and use them as First actions.

abilities.name: Bolts of Power
abilities.description: Release four lightning bolts against up to four targets in short range; missed targets still take 1 damage.

abilities.name: Closed Loop Body
abilities.description: You do not need to eat or breathe and suffer no environmental effects from vacuum or extreme temperatures.

abilities.name: Cybernetic Alacrity
abilities.description: Effort on a noncombat Speed task also grants a free Effort level or a minor effect.

abilities.name: Embedded Drone
abilities.description: Launch and control a tiny built-in drone with manipulators and a firearm until a one-hour recovery.
